about: RAW exposure brackets posted to discuss.pixls.us (mostly Play Raw threads), for developing and checking Merge to HDR. Each author licenses the files in the thread's opening post (license_statement quotes it), which overrides the forum's default CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (https://discuss.pixls.us/tos section 3); a file the statement does not cover carries that default. Credit each bracket's author by username with a link to the thread. role 'frame' is one exposure of the bracket; 'comparison' is the author's own merge, kept to compare against, never a frame. ev is each frame's exposure (shutter x ISO / f-number^2) against the bracket's middle frame. Files live in raws/play-raw/<bracket>/; scripts/dataset.py play-raw downloads, checks and indexes them.

39443-piney-sunrise.title: Piney sunrise as it looked ... ?
39443-piney-sunrise.author: lphilpot
39443-piney-sunrise.license_statement: These files are licensed Creative Commons, By-Attribution, Share-Alike.
39443-piney-sunrise.bracket: 3 frames, AEB 0 / -2 / +2 EV (shutter 1/5, 1/20, 0.8 s at f/11, ISO 100, manual exposure), started in that order within 0.5 s.
39443-piney-sunrise.support: tripod: the frames line up to the pixel (no shift measured on the previews), and the +2 EV frame is 0.8 s.
39443-piney-sunrise.motion: none measured; pine needles may move in the wind over the 0.8 s frame.
39443-piney-sunrise.clipping: the sun is in frame, low behind the pines: even the -2 EV frame clips its disc (0.03% of photosites); 0 EV clips 0.5%, +2 EV 10% (sky).
39443-piney-sunrise.notes: The camera's EXIF Copyright reads 'Copyright Len Philpot, All Rights Reserved', which conflicts with the CC BY-SA 4.0 the author (lphilpot) grants in the opening post; the post is the later, explicit grant and is what this dataset relies on. The author posted their own HDR (merged in Affinity Photo) as a JPEG only, so there is no comparison file.

39864-hdr-colours-xtrans.title: I struggle with HDR colors in darktable (and HDRMerge)
39864-hdr-colours-xtrans.author: gigaturbo
39864-hdr-colours-xtrans.license_statement: All files are licensed CC BY-SA.
39864-hdr-colours-xtrans.bracket: 3 frames, camera AEB set to -1 2/3, -1/3 and +1 EV compensation; measured exposures -1.44 / 0 / +1.13 EV (1/950 and 1/350 s at ISO 160, 1/200 s at ISO 200, f/8).
39864-hdr-colours-xtrans.support: handheld: the frames drift by about 5 px at full resolution.
39864-hdr-colours-xtrans.motion: foliage and clouds; no people or vehicles.
39864-hdr-colours-xtrans.clipping: the darkest frame is unclipped (99.9th percentile 0.4 EV below clip); the middle frame clips 2% (bright clouds), the brightest 9.5%.
39864-hdr-colours-xtrans.notes: The thread is about HDRMerge's colours and alignment on X-Trans: comparison/DSCF4066-4068.dng is the author's HDRMerge 0.5.0 merge (floating-point X-Trans DNG), which the author says shows alignment artifacts because HDRMerge does not align X-Trans frames.

21441-car-at-sunrise.title: Car at sunrise - Bracketed shots
21441-car-at-sunrise.author: zhopudey
21441-car-at-sunrise.license_statement: This file is licensed Creative Commons, By-Attribution, Share-Alike.
21441-car-at-sunrise.bracket: 5 frames in 1 EV steps, shot 0 / -2 / -1 / +1 / +2 EV (1/400, 1/1600, 1/800, 1/200, 1/100 s at f/9, ISO 400, aperture priority) within 1.3 s.
21441-car-at-sunrise.support: handheld: the frames drift steadily, up to about 30 px at full resolution (VR on).
21441-car-at-sunrise.motion: the sea moves (waves and the sun's glitter); grass may move; the car is still.
21441-car-at-sunrise.clipping: the sun sits on the horizon: even the -2 EV frame clips its disc (0.01% of photosites); +1 EV clips 4.5%, +2 EV 25% (sky).
21441-car-at-sunrise.notes: The author reports dust spots on the sensor or lens. File names keep the author's capture-time prefix (07.16.48 is the second the series started; the EXIF time of the first frame is 07:16:47.85).

29470-hdr-scenery.title: HDR scenery black point issue
29470-hdr-scenery.author: Newerth
29470-hdr-scenery.license_statement: the raws are licensed Creative Commons — Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International — CC BY-SA 4.0.

files.license_note: The opening post licenses 'the raws' only; this HDRMerge output falls under the forum's default license (https://discuss.pixls.us/tos section 3).

29470-hdr-scenery.bracket: 3 frames in 1 EV steps, camera AEB at -1 2/3, -2/3 and +1/3 EV compensation: -1 / 0 / +1 EV (1/6400, 1/3200, 1/1600 s at f/2.8, ISO 200) within 0.26 s.
29470-hdr-scenery.support: handheld: the frames shift by about 4 px at full resolution.
29470-hdr-scenery.motion: ghosting test: a person walks through the foreground between frames, and small figures move in the distance; bare branches against the sky.
29470-hdr-scenery.clipping: sun rays through cloud: the darkest frame is unclipped (99.9th percentile 1 EV below clip); the middle frame clips 0.06%, the brightest 1.1%.
29470-hdr-scenery.notes: The thread asks why HDRMerge's result shows a magenta tint and a wrong black point: comparison/P1210701-1210703.dng is that HDRMerge 0.5.0 output (32-bit float DNG). The opening post licenses 'the raws' only, so the merged DNG falls under the forum's default CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

54315-cave-grand-canyon.title: Looking out of a cave to see the canyon below
54315-cave-grand-canyon.author: daithi
54315-cave-grand-canyon.license_statement: This file is licensed Creative Commons, By-Attribution, Share-Alike.
54315-cave-grand-canyon.bracket: 5 frames at a fixed 1/60 s and f/8: the camera's AEB varied ISO only (500, 400, 640, 320, 800), giving 0 / -0.32 / +0.36 / -0.64 / +0.68 EV (nominal 0, ±1/3, ±2/3) within about 2 s.
54315-cave-grand-canyon.support: handheld: the frames drift up to about 30 px at full resolution.
54315-cave-grand-canyon.clipping: the sunlit canyon wall seen from the cave is clipped in every frame, even the darkest (1.9% of photosites, ISO 320); the brightest clips 4.2%. The author notes the steps were too small.
54315-cave-grand-canyon.notes: An ISO bracket, not an exposure bracket: every frame collected the same light, so the merge gains highlight headroom only from the lower analog gain (1.3 EV between ISO 800 and 320) and no cleaner shadows. A test for merges that weight frames by exposure time alone, and for unrecoverable clipping. EXIF has no subsecond times. The author's edit of the darkest frame (P1060781) was posted as a JPEG and an XMP, which are not kept.
